An implemented plan to increase agent output, featuring defined benchmarks and measurable tactical growth drivers. Established field sales performance routines, including weekly and monthly reviews, executed against standardized templates with disciplined action tracking. Optimized cost per new active customer, trending within the approved thresholds.

title: Head, POS Recovery
description: Who We Are Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month. As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually. Job Title: POS Recovery Manager Department: POS Channel Reports to: VP, POS Channel About this role: This role owns the end-to-end recovery of non-performing POS terminal assets — from the moment a terminal is flagged as at risk through to physical retrieval, financial settlement, and post-write-off recovery. Responsibilities Recovery Strategy Governance Own the terminal recovery lifecycle that defines escalation speed and settlement windows based on terminal age, transaction history, and recovery economics.  Ensure every terminal that enters recovery mode is assigned, tracked, escalated on schedule, and settled within its gate deadline — recovery, write-off, paid write-off, or insurance claim.  Design and continuously refine the recovery strategy, covering device collection, swap logistics, sales agent coordination, external agency management, and the efficient flow of assets back to custody.  Field Team Leadership Lead, manage, and hold accountable a distributed field recovery team across multiple regions.  Instill a culture of operational discipline, accountability, and ethical conduct. Recovery work involves sensitive situations (confronting custodians about lost assets, handling disputes, managing bounty payments); the team must operate with integrity.  Develop comprehensive standard operating procedures for every recovery scenario: BRM-led recovery, external agency coordination, business takeover, faulty terminal collection, voluntary write-off processing, dispute handling, revive processing.  Build training programmes for recovery agents covering: terminal identification, check-in procedures, evidence collection for disputes, GPS and field management tools, escalation protocols.  KPI Management and Recovery Economics Define and track recovery KPIs: recovery rate (pre-write-off), BRM recovery rate, external recovery rate, average days to recovery, cost per recovery, revive rate (post-write-off), bounty efficiency (bounty spend vs recovery value recovered).  Own the recovery economics: ensure total bounty spend plus logistics cost is always less than the recovery value of the terminals retrieved. The programme must be self-funding — recovery must generate more value than it costs.  Report monthly on: terminals entering recovery mode, terminals recovered, terminals written off, terminals revived, net financial impact, bounty spend, external agency spend, dispute volumes and outcomes.  Experience & Background Minimum 7 years of progressive experience managing large-scale field operations, logistics, asset recovery, or after-sales service, with at least 3 years in a senior leadership role.  Experience managing distributed field teams across multiple regions in Nigeria — you understand the infrastructure, the logistics constraints, and the human dynamics of field recovery operations.  Experience managing third-party service providers, contractors, or agency networks with performance-based contracts.  Direct experience in the Nigerian market with its specific logistical, regulatory, and operational realities.  Preferred: Experience from fintech, telecoms, e-commerce logistics, or any high-volume distributed asset management environment.  Preferred: Experience managing asset recovery at scale (thousands of units per month, not dozens).  Skills & Competencies Proven ability to design and implement structured operational processes (SOPs, escalation frameworks, settlement procedures) from scratch or through a major restructure.  Strong analytical capability — you use data to drive decisions, track performance, calculate ROI on recovery spend.  Financial discipline & budget management — experience managing a budget or cost centre, understanding unit economics, and demonstrating net positive recovery value.  Technical & Systems acumen — experience with product management/development lifecycles (writing briefs, working with engineers), GPS tracking, CRM, field management tools, or route optimisation platforms.  Regulatory & Compliance understanding — familiarity with insurance claim processes, write-off accounting, or asset disposal regulations in Nigeria.  What Success Looks Like in This Role Terminal recovery lifecycle is tightly governed, ensuring swift escalation and settlement within established gate deadlines.  Field recovery operations maintain high ethical standards and operational discipline across all regions.  Recovery program operates as a self-funding unit where total recovery value generated consistently exceeds total bounty and logistics expenditure.  Robust systems, SOPs, and field management tools are seamlessly integrated into daily team operations.  Transparent monthly reporting clearly demonstrates positive net financial impact and high recovery/revive rates.  Why Join Us?  Competitive compensation, benefits, and career growth opportunities.  Support for professional development and a dynamic culture driving financial inclusion across Africa.

title: Metadata & Data Lineage Specialist
description: Who we are  Moniepoint is an all-in-one digital financial services platform powering businesses across emerging markets. Since 2019, our technology has enabled over one million businesses to thrive through comprehensive payment, banking, credit, and business management solutions. Operating through its subsidiaries—including Moniepoint MFB and TeamApt Ltd—Moniepoint processes the majority of Nigeria's POS transactions, representing over $170 billion in annualised Total Payment Volume (TPV). Recognised as Africa’s second-fastest-growing fintech platform and named the Most Inclusive Payment Platform by the Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) in 2022, Moniepoint continues to scale its profitable financial ecosystem. About this role We are looking for a Metadata & Data Lineage Specialist to build out and run the organization's metadata management and data lineage capabilities. You will be the person who makes our data catalogue genuinely useful — helping teams find, trust, and understand the data they are working with, and tracing exactly how that data moves and transforms across our systems. You will take our metadata management and data lineage frameworks from paper to practice: growing coverage, improving quality, automating collection wherever possible, and building lineage that holds up for our most critical data products, regulatory submissions, and business-critical flows. Responsibilities Metadata Management & Data Cataloguing: Maintain and enhance enterprise metadata, developing business glossaries, data definitions, and ownership frameworks within DataHub. Identify gaps and ensure metadata changes align with governance processes. Data Lineage Management: Develop, maintain, and validate end-to-end data lineage for critical data flows, products, reports, and customer journeys across source systems, ETL/ELT pipelines, and downstream consumers. DataHub Platform & Integration: Support the administration and optimisation of DataHub. Configure ingestion workflows, monitor metadata ingestion jobs, and identify opportunities to improve coverage through automation and APIs. Metadata Quality & Governance: Establish metadata quality rules and KPIs. Perform regular assessments to highlight gaps, support data impact assessments, and ensure alignment with enterprise governance policies. Data Classification & Privacy: Apply data classification metadata based on sensitivity and regulatory requirements. Support Risk, Compliance, and InfoSec teams with necessary lineage information for assessments. AI & Advanced Data Discovery: Drive the adoption of AI-assisted metadata management to automate capture, classification, and enrichment. Contribute to the development of semantic models and knowledge graphs. Stakeholder Engagement: Act as a subject matter expert, facilitating workshops and providing guidance to data producers and consumers to improve overall data literacy and DataHub adoption. Experience & Background Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Management, Data Science, Information Systems, Library/Information Science, Engineering, or a related discipline. 3–6+ years of experience in Metadata Management, Data Governance, Data Architecture, or Data Engineering. Demonstrable hands-on experience with Solidatus, Informatica, DataHub, or a comparable enterprise data catalog platform. Practical experience developing end-to-end data lineage across complex data environments. Deep familiarity with modern data architectures (Medallion, Data Mesh, Data Vault 2.0, warehouses, data lakes, cloud platforms). Experience in financial services, fintech, payments, banking, or another highly regulated data environment is highly desirable. Skills & Competencies Strong proficiency working with technical and business metadata, business glossaries, data domains, and data classification. Experience working with relational databases and a solid understanding of SQL and database structures. Knowledge of APIs, ETL/ELT pipelines, and automated metadata integration. Familiarity with AI-assisted metadata management, semantic modelling, ontologies, and knowledge graph concepts. Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to facilitate training and influence adoption. Professional certification in Data Management or Architecture (e.g., DAMA CDMP, CIMP, DCAM) or related platform certifications are advantageous. What success looks like in this role The enterprise data catalogue is accurate, easily discoverable, and heavily utilised by cross-functional teams to understand data assets. End-to-end data lineage is robust, validated, and actively supports critical data products, regulatory submissions, and incident investigations. Metadata collection is highly automated, maintaining strict quality standards and governance controls with minimal manual intervention. Data literacy and platform adoption (DataHub) scale across the organisation through effective stakeholder enablement. What we can offer you Culture -We put our people first and prioritise the well-being of every team member. We’ve built a company where all opinions carry weight and where all voices are heard. We value and respect each other and always look out for one another. Above all, we are human. Learning - We have a learning and development-focused environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing, training, and regular internal technical talks. Compensation - You’ll receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance, annual bonus, plus other benefits. What to expect in the hiring process A preliminary phone call with the recruiter A technical interview with the hiring manager A behavioural and technical interview with a member of the Executive team.  Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

acquisition Build and maintain campaign structures optimised for Moniepoint's dual-product funnel — separating signals, audiences, and bidding logic appropriately across segments Set bidding strategies, budget allocation frameworks, and creative testing cycles that reduce dependence on any single signal or format Own campaign performance end-to-end: from brief to launch to optimisation to reporting Tracking, Attribution & Technical Infrastructure Architect and own the full measurement stack: Firebase / GA4 event taxonomy, Google Tag Manager configuration, and server-side event pipelines Lead the implementation and ongoing integrity of Conversion APIs and enhanced conversions to maximise signal quality sent back to Google Define the attribution model — evaluate last-click, data-driven, and custom models against Moniepoint's funnel reality, and own the decision with clear reasoning Partner with engineering and data teams to ensure event data flowing to Google is accurate, complete, and timely — treating signal quality as a competitive asset Build audit protocols for tracking coverage and attribution consistency; surface gaps before they distort decisions LTV/CAC Economics Own the economic model for Google acquisition: define CAC targets by product, segment, and channel variant; set the inputs, assumptions, and review cadence Understand the LTV/CAC relationship at a structural level — not just as a ratio to optimise, but as a function of product retention, monetisation curves, and cohort behaviour Build and iterate on payback period models that diagnosis — channel mix, audience quality, creative fatigue, product-market fit — before it becomes a financial problem Governance & Reporting Build a channel reporting system that surfaces reality performance into business language for senior stakeholders: what is the cost of growth, is it sustainable, and what would change the trajectory Emerging Market & Fintech Context Adapt Google acquisition strategy for the realities of emerging market users: variable device penetration, low-bandwidth environments, trust barriers to financial services, and diverse language/literacy contexts patterns distinguish sustainable fintech growth from subsidised growth in markets like Nigeria To succeed in this role, you should have: 6+ years of hands-on paid acquisition experience, with the majority of that time spent on Google UAC / App Campaigns at meaningful scale Deep, demonstrable technical knowledge of Google's campaign infrastructure: bidding algorithms, audience signals, creative specs, and the mechanics of Smart Bidding Proven ability to architect and own the full measurement stack — Firebase, GA4, GTM, Conversion APIs — not just configure it but understand why each component matters Fluency in LTV/CAC modelling: you have built the models, owned the assumptions, and used them to make real budgeting and bidding decisions Experience operating in a fintech or financial services context, with direct knowledge of the acquisition compliance and trust dynamics unique to financial products Strongly Preferred Experience managing budgets larger that 10 Million USD annually Experience running Google acquisition in Sub-Saharan Africa or comparable emerging markets — Nigeria specifically is a significant advantage Familiarity with server-side conversion APIs, offline conversion imports, and enhanced conversions as mechanisms for improving signal quality in cookieless or app-first environments Experience working with data science or analytics teams to build custom bidding signals and offline LTV imports into Google's systems Prior work on dual-product or dual-segment acquisition (e.g., consumer and SME / business) with separate funnel logic What Success Looks Like In the first 90 days Full audit of existing Google campaign structure, tracking integrity, and attribution model completed — with a written assessment and prioritised improvement plan Measurement stack gaps identified and remediation underway with engineering LTV/CAC baseline model built with documented assumptions, reviewed with Growth and Finance First governance cadence established — weekly performance review with clear owner, metrics, and follow-through log In the first year Google channel operating as a reliable, scalable growth engine with predictable CAC across both personal and business banking segments Signal quality measurably improved — higher match rates, cleaner conversion data, reduced reliance on last-click proxies Attribution model validated against actual cohort data and actively used in budget allocation decisions Playbook documented: campaign architecture, bidding logic, audience strategy, and economic model all institutionalised — not living in one person's head A team (or foundations for one) built with clear ownership, development paths, and no single point of failure What to expect in the hiring process A preliminary phone call with the recruiter  A technical interview with the hiring manager A Case Study A behavioural and technical interview with a member of the Executive team All interview stages are virtual

title: Principal Mobile Engineer (POS Terminal)
description: Who we are Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.  As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually. About the role As a Principal Mobile Engineer (POS-Terminal) at Moniepoint, you will be responsible for designing and leading the architecture of our POS terminal solutions across multiple platforms. You will ensure the scalability, security, performance, and reliability of our POS systems and related applications, including mobile apps for repair scheduling and maintenance. While the majority of our terminals are currently based on Android Native, your expertise in cross-platform solutions (e.g., Flutter, C, JavaScript) will be crucial as we expand and diversify our portfolio.You’ll play a critical role in shaping the direction of our POS-related products, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and ensuring the technical vision aligns with the company’s broader strategic goals. Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out posts on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth. What you will do: Lead the design and architecture of POS terminal solutions, ensuring security, scalability, performance, and integration with various hardware and payment systems. Develop and maintain architectural documents and diagrams for POS terminal systems, ensuring all platforms are well documented and up to date. Make architectural decisions on POS terminal software, integrating various payment technologies, EMV standards, and ensuring hardware compatibility. Lead the development of POS-related applications Optimize system performance and security, particularly around payment processing and EMV protocols. Participate in planning sessions with product and engineering teams to ensure solutions meet market needs and business goals. Conduct code reviews and ensure best practices for mobile and embedded systems development, especially for Android Native development. Define and enforce software engineering best practices across the POS and related teams to improve efficiency and developer productivity. Ensure the stability and reliability of POS terminal products and applications, monitoring system performance and troubleshooting as necessary. Provide technical mentorship to engineering teams, helping them grow their skills and contribute to the broader technical vision. Participate in the hiring process, screening engineers with expertise in POS systems, mobile, and embedded development. To succeed in this role, we think you should have: At least 8 years of experience in system design, architecture, and development, specifically in the POS terminal domain. Strong expertise in Android Native development (Java/Kotlin), with a deep understanding of Android-based POS terminal solutions. Experience in cross-platform mobile development, such as Flutter, and familiarity with other POS application platforms (e.g., C, JavaScript) is a plus. Strong knowledge of EMV (Europay, Mastercard, and Visa) security protocols, including chip-based transactions, encryption, and key management. Experience with hardware integration for POS devices, such as card readers, pin pads, printers, and other peripherals. title: Product Auditor
description: Who We Are Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.  As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually. What We Do At Moniepoint, we are a customer-focused community dedicated to crafting solutions that redefine our industry. We leverage artificial intelligence and data-driven best practices to support our businesses, from providing credit and overdrafts to ensuring every transaction is secure. Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out our stories on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth. Role Overview The Product Auditor provides independent assurance over the design, implementation, and operating effectiveness of product controls across payment, wallet, settlement, switches and other related products across the organisation The role ensures that new and existing products are deployed with adequate financial, operational, security, and regulatory controls, safeguarding the organization against revenue leakage, settlement failures, regulatory breaches, and technology-driven risks. The Product Auditor will independently evaluate product risk exposure and control maturity prior to scale. Key Responsibilities  Audit Universe & Risk-Based Planning Maintain a living Product Audit Universe covering all payment products, features, and integrations ranked by risk.  Own the annual Product Audit Plan, ensuring coverage is allocated dynamically based on risk ratings, product complexity, regulatory sensitivity, and change velocity. Product Design & Control Assurance Review PRDs, business rules, and transaction workflows to identify logic gaps, unmitigated risk paths, and missing exception-handling routines before products reach production/go-live.  Analyse product path scenarios, verify Maker-Checker enforcement, and provide formal control design sign-off before any material release goes live. Live Product Assessment ( Continuous Audit Review) Periodically assess live payment products to confirm they continue to operate within approved design parameters.  Detect configuration drift, identify silent divergence from original PRDs, and analyse live transaction data for emerging risk patterns. Go-Live Readiness & Control Gate Execute mandatory pre-production Product Audit reviews as an independent control gate for all material releases.  Confirm reconciliation logic, exception queues, and fallback controls are tested and functional.  Escalate critical deficiencies with risk ratings and hold recommendations where a product is not safe to release. Transaction Logic & Mathematical Integrity Interrogate the Fee Engine using SQL to mathematically prove that commissions, VAT, discounts, and splits are posted with complete precision.  Validate duplicate prevention mechanisms and ensure transaction integrity within complex, multi-step payment sequences, and test reversal, refund, and chargeback logic to confirm financial symmetry is maintained in every scenario. Settlement & Ledger Integrity Trace fund flows, confirming continuous synchronisation between wallet sub-ledgers and the General Ledger.  Assess reconciliation logic for breaks and evaluate the authorisation, documentation, and reversibility of manual settlement overrides. Product Change & Configuration Integrity Confirm that all product modifications: fee tables, routing rules, limit parameters passed through an approved change management cycle.  Identify silent changes made outside formal release processes and audit the integrity of product master data to ensure it is access-controlled, version-tracked, and consistent with approved product terms. Vendor & Third-Party Product Risk Assess controls over vendor-managed product components, evaluate SLA performance against contractual commitments, and identify single-vendor dependency risks within critical payment flows.  Evaluate the organisation's ability to detect unilateral changes in third-party API behaviour, fee logic, or settlement processes. Control Advisory & Stakeholder Engagement Engage product and engineering teams early in the design cycle to provide informal control advisory, reducing findings at the formal review stage without compromising independence.  Participate in design reviews and architecture discussions, and build a control-by-design culture across product teams.  Incident Review, RCA & Regulatory Alignment Lead post-incident reviews for product failures,producing structured RCA reports that identify underlying logic failures, not just surface symptoms.  Assess corrective actions for adequacy and track findings to verify closure.  Ensure product logic complies with CBN guidelines, PCI DSS, and consumer protection obligations at the design level, and evaluate the regulatory impact of new features before release. Reporting & Governance Prepare risk-rated audit reports for Executive Management and the Audit Committee, leading with findings, financial impact, and required action.  Maintain a Product Risk Register, deliver quarterly control maturity updates, and ensure governance bodies are never surprised by a product failure that was visible at the design or portfolio review stage. Required Knowledge & Skills  Technical Skills Advanced SQL for independent data extraction and transaction interrogation Payment systems architecture : Wallets, card processing, direct debit, settlement, and reconciliation API and integration literacy (Basic) End-to-end transaction lifecycle knowledge: Authorisation, posting, clearing, settlement, and exception handling PRD and process flow analysis: translating product documentation into control flowcharts Mathematical precision: fee calculations, interest computations, and split payment structures Pattern recognition: detecting anomalies, outliers, and irregularities in large transaction datasets Audit & Risk Skills Risk-based audit methodology: IIA Standards and COSO framework applied to financial products. Control design logic and evaluation Root cause analysis Regulatory knowledge: CBN payment system regulations, PCI DSS, NDPR,Nigerian consumer protection obligations etc Interpersonal & Professional Skills Stakeholder engagement Professional scepticism and independence Risk-rated report writing Tools & Platforms SQL (PostgreSQL / MySQL / MSSQL) AdvancedExcel / Google Sheets Claude / AI Tools Qualifications Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Finance, or a related quantitative discipline Experience: 3–5+ years in Product Audit, Systems Audit, Financial Data Analytics, or Payment Operations within a fintech or financial services environment Certifications: CISA, CIA, or CFE preferred. ACA / ACCA is acceptable when combined with strong technical product experience and data analytics. Sector Knowledge: Demonstrated hands-on familiarity with payment product architecture, wallet systems, and regulated payment flows in a Nigerian or comparable market context. What We Offer You Culture: We put our people first and prioritize the well-being of every team member. We’re human, we listen, and we look out for one another. Learning: We’re big on growth. You’ll find an environment focused on knowledge sharing, training, and helping you reach your potential. Compensation: You’ll receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance, and an annual bonus, along with other great benefits. What to Expect in the Hiring Process A preliminary phone call with our recruiter. An interview with the hiring team. A final conversation with a member of our executive team. Moniepoint Inc. is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

title: Product Design Manager - Design System
description: Who we are Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial ecosystem, helping 10 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, and business management tools since 2019. As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, it powers most of the country’s Point of Sale (POS) transactions. Through its subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes $22 billion monthly for its customers while operating profitably. Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out posts on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth. About the role  Designing for money means designing for trust. Our customers are shop owners, traders and entrepreneurs, and many are new to digital products. They work on low-end devices and unreliable networks, where one confusing screen can cost them a sale. Your team's work has to hold up for them, whatever their ability or device. You make sure it does.  As a Design Manager, you'll lead a small team of product designers and be accountable for everything they ship: its quality, how it works as one product, and the results it drives for our customers and the business. Your team works either on the products our customers use on POS, mobile and web, or on the operational tools our teams use to serve them.  It is a hands-on role: you build the systems the team works within and step into the hardest problems yourself.  What you'll do  Set the design direction for your area, turn it into plans with milestones and measurable outcomes, and make the case for it to senior leaders in customer and business terms. Work with product partners so every designer begins from a clear, well-framed brief, and push back early when one isn't ready.  Keep each customer journey whole across teams, and resolve conflicting designs before they launch.  Run critique and design reviews against a definition of done that includes accessibility, and stay close enough to the work that nothing reaches customers below the bar. Decide what must be tested with customers before build and what can ship and be measured after, and plan that validation into delivery with success metrics defined up front. Make sure journeys use the design system, with market and product variations handled inside it rather than as one-off rebuilds. Plan and staff system contributions like any other project. Build trusted partnerships with product and engineering, so design shapes what gets built, and design and engineering stay in step through build.  Hire well, set clear expectations, give direct feedback, and build a growth path for each designer.  Bring AI tools into the team's design process, model effective and responsible use in your own work, and build that fluency across the team.  What you'll need to succeed  10+ years of experience in product design, with a portfolio of shipped work across mobile and web that shows the problem, your decisions and the results.  3+ years of experience managing product designers, including hiring, coaching and career development.  Experience setting design direction for a product area and leading a team to deliver it. Experience running a design quality practice, such as critique, design reviews and a definition of done, that raised the quality of shipped work.  Experience building shared patterns or templates adopted across teams, products or markets. Experience shipping accessible, inclusive products for people with disabilities, people new to digital products and people on limited devices and connectivity.  Experience using AI tools in design work and building that fluency across a team.  Nice to have  Experience designing for POS terminals is a strong plus. Experience in financial services, multiple markets or operational tools is also welcome.  What you will get: A leadership role in shaping the future of fintech - your work will impact millions of users. Career growth opportunities. A culture of experimentation - we encourage innovative thinking and rapid iteration. Competitive compensation and benefits. Remote-friendly work culture, with access to learning resources. What to expect in the hiring process  Recruiter conversation. Your background, what you want next, and practical details. 2. Case study review. Walk a design leader through one or two case studies in depth: one from your own work, one from a team you led.  Leadership challenge. Work through a product and team problem live with two design leaders.  Final interview. A conversation with the hiring manager. Why Join Us Competitive compensation, benefits, and career growth opportunities. Fully remote work culture and support for professional development. What to expect in the hiring process Application & portfolio review: we assess your experience, leadership impact, and Design System case studies that demonstrate strategic thinking, process, and measurable outcomes. Preliminary phone call with recruiter: a brief conversation to discuss your background, leadership experience, and expectations. Interview with senior leadership: a deep dive into your leadership approach, design philosophy, and ability to drive impact. This includes a discussion on past projects and collaboration with cross-functional teams. Design leadership challenge: a scenario-based assessment to assess both strategic thinking and leadership skills while balancing UX/UI expertise. Final executive conversation: a discussion with senior leadership to assess alignment with our vision, strategic thinking, and team-building philosophy. How to apply: Submit your resume and portfolio showcasing your leadership in managing design teams, driving strategy, and delivering user-centred solutions with measurable business impact. We want to see case studies that demonstrate how you have led and developed designers, prioritised and managed projects, and fostered a high-performing team culture. Your portfolio should highlight how you have used research, data, and experimentation to inform decisions, optimise workflows, and drive success metrics.

title: Regional Lead, Client Implementation
description: Who We Are Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.  As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually. What We Do At Moniepoint, we are a customer-focused community dedicated to crafting solutions that redefine our industry. We leverage artificial intelligence and data-driven best practices to support our businesses, from providing credit and overdrafts to ensuring every transaction is secure. Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out our stories on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth. Job Purpose The Implementation Lead is responsible for building, managing, and continuously improving a high-performing regional team of Implementation agents. This role drives the strategic execution of Moniebook's customer onboarding programme at scale, ensuring that every new retail customer in the region is successfully activated, trained, and transitioned into a confident, long-term user of the Moniebook solution. Operating at the intersection of people leadership, operational excellence, and customer success strategy, the Implementation Lead sets performance standards, develops team capability, removes escalation blockers, and partners cross-functionally with Sales, Product, and Account Management to deliver a world-class onboarding experience. Success is measured by team-wide activation rates, time-to-value benchmarks, retention outcomes, and the quality of customer handoffs across the region measure success. Key Responsibilities Team Leadership & Performance Management Recruit, onboard, coach, and retain a regional team of Implementation Agents, fostering a culture of accountability, customer obsession, and continuous improvement. Set clear individual and team performance goals aligned to activation rates, time-to-value, feature adoption, CSAT scores, and churn reduction targets. Conduct regular 1:1s, team reviews, and performance evaluations; identify skill gaps and build development plans to close them. Onboarding Strategy & Programme Oversight Design scalable onboarding frameworks that allow the team to manage growing customer volumes without compromising on quality or personalisation. Define and maintain onboarding milestones, success metrics, and quality standards across all customer segments. Identify opportunities to streamline onboarding timelines and reduce time-to-value without sacrificing adoption depth. Escalation Management & Issue Resolution Act as the first point of escalation for complex technical issues, difficult customer situations, or onboarding stalls that agents are unable to resolve independently. Partner with Product, Engineering, and Support teams to drive resolution of systemic issues affecting onboarding outcomes across the region. Maintain clear escalation pathways and SLA standards, ensuring customers always feel supported and informed during issue resolution. Cross-functional Collaboration Partner closely with the Sales team to ensure smooth pre-to-post sale handoffs and that customer expectations are properly set before onboarding begins. Collaborate with Account Managers to refine the handoff process, ensuring agents provide complete, high-quality context that enables seamless long-term retention. Work with the Product team to surface recurring customer pain points, usability gaps, and feature adoption blockers, acting as a regional voice of the customer. Data, Reporting & Insights Track and analyse team-wide performance data including activation rates, onboarding completion timelines, feature adoption depth, CSAT scores, and early-stage churn metrics. Produce regular reports for senior leadership on regional onboarding health, trends, risks, and improvement initiatives. Use data to identify underperforming segments, agents, or onboarding touchpoints, and drive targeted interventions to address root causes. Process Improvement & Innovation Continuously review and refine onboarding processes, tools, and resources to improve efficiency, consistency, and customer outcomes. Champion the adoption of new technologies, automation, or methodologies that can enhance the team's ability to deliver high-touch onboarding at scale. Build a feedback loop between frontline agent insights and senior leadership/product decisions to ensure ground-level learnings influence the business. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, Operations, or a related field (or equivalent experience). 4 - 6 years of experience in customer onboarding, customer success, or implementation roles, with at least 2–3 years in a team lead or people management capacity. Proven track record of leading onboarding or CS teams to consistently achieve activation, adoption, and retention targets, ideally within SaaS, retail technology, or fintech. Strong people leadership skills with the ability to motivate, develop, and hold a distributed team accountable for outcomes. Excellent analytical skills, able to interpret customer health data, team performance metrics, and identify actionable trends. Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills; able to present to senior leadership, navigate cross-functional relationships, and represent the customer voice persuasively. Deep customer empathy combined with a results-driven orientation. Highly organised with demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, projects, and escalations simultaneously without compromising quality. Comfortable working in fast-paced, ambiguous environments; brings structure and clarity without over-engineering. Preferred Qualifications Experience building or scaling onboarding teams from the ground up in a high-growth technology company. Exposure to retail operations, merchant services, or point-of-sale technology. Experience designing training curricula, onboarding playbooks, or knowledge management systems. Familiarity with customer health scoring methodologies, NPS/CSAT frameworks, or CS operations best practices. About You You are a natural leader who takes genuine pride in developing the people around you, and you measure your success by the success of your team and your customers. You are strategic and execution-focused; you can zoom out to design the right system and zoom in to resolve a customer escalation on the same day. You bring calm, clarity, and decisiveness under pressure. When things go wrong, your team looks to you and finds confidence, not panic. You are deeply data-literate; you use numbers to tell stories, make decisions, and hold yourself and your team accountable. You are a collaborative partner who builds trust across functions, Sales, Product, Support, and Account Management, and all see you as an ally, not a blocker. You thrive in environments where the playbook is still being written, and you take ownership of writing it. You are customer-obsessed at scale, even as you move further from direct customer interaction, you never lose sight of the human beings behind the metrics. What Success Looks Like Your regional team consistently achieves 90%+ customer activation rates within the 30–60 day onboarding window, month over month. Average time-to-live for customers in your region is at or below the 1–2 week target, with no systemic delays attributed to onboarding execution gaps. Regional post-onboarding CSAT scores average 4.5+, and your team's handoff quality is rated as excellent by Account Managers. Early-stage churn (within 90 days post-onboarding) for customers in your region remains below 5%. Your agents are among the most skilled and engaged at Moniebook, attrition on your team is low, development is visible, and performance is strong. You have documented, improved, and operationalised at least two significant enhancements to the regional onboarding playbook each quarter. You don't just react to incidents; you build the systems that prevent them. Key Responsibilities Safeguard our People and Assets: Lead the implementation of security policies that protect our team, offices, and equipment across your region. Master the Environment: Conduct regular security assessments to spot vulnerabilities and design innovative strategies to reduce risk. Lead the Front Line: Supervise and mentor private security guards and armed police personnel, ensuring they perform their duties with mastery and respect. Innovate for Safety: Stay ahead of security trends and technology (like CCTV and access control) to keep our regional operations modern and resilient. Support Business Resilience: Provide expert guidance on asset recovery and fraud investigation when the business needs your mastery. Qualifications Professional Background: Should have at least 5 years of experience successfully leading a security team in a guard services/physical security company or have 5 years of experience as an ex-commissioned service personnel supervisor—either in the military, police, or paramilitary. Education: A Bachelor’s degree in Criminology, Psychology, Criminal Justice, or a related field. Certification: You hold a recognized security certification such as CPP, PSP, or CPO. Integrity: A clean criminal record and the ability to pass a comprehensive background check are essential. Language & Culture: You speak the local dialects of the major tribes in your assigned region, allowing you to connect with the community. Good experience working with automated security systems like CCTV cameras, burglary alarm systems, etc. About You You are a Hero: You are driven by mastery and the desire to protect others. People count on you to come through when things get tough. You are Relatable: You don’t hide behind technical jargon. You communicate clearly and build trust with everyone, from the security guards to the executive team. You are Proactive: You don’t wait for things to go wrong. You have the "Creator" spirit, always looking for better ways to secure our future.  You are composed: In high-pressure situations, you are the calmest person in the room. title: Senior Content Designer
description: About Us: Moniepoint Group is a financial technology company digitizing Africa’s real economy by building a financial ecosystem for businesses, providing them with all the payment, banking, credit and business management tools they need to succeed. You support junior content designers, influence cross-team content strategy, and play a vital role in driving alignment across product, design, and engineering. You display an exceptional grasp of design thinking and content design expertise and are comfortable delivering well-thought out ideas to senior stakeholders and driving content design strategy each day.  What you’ll do  You are responsible for end-to-end content design strategy and execution on a project, from discovery through delivery, launch, and ongoing iteration. Partnering closely with product managers, product designers, and engineers to embed content strategy in product discovery and delivery, shaping scope, trade-offs, and sequencing. Define for exceptional, accessible, and inclusive content that builds trust, clarity, and meaningful user engagement. Comfortable wireframing and prototyping and delivering your work in Figma, with clear rationale, adhering to a design systems and content design principles. Define content design strategy that aligns with business objectives and technical feasibility, ensuring content is not just clear but emotionally intelligent and on brand. Craft high-quality content for complex product flows, interface text, microcopy, error messaging, help content, and documentation, setting the bar for tone, clarity, and consistency. Take a strong role in qualitative and quantitative research methods (user interviews, usability tests, A/B experiments, content audits, analytics) using insight as a core design input. Collaborate deeply, proactively shaping product direction, surfacing trade-offs, and influencing delivery approaches. Drive the evolution of content design style guides, working closely with brand, marketing, and communications teams. Design thoughtful content that enhances usability, emotional impact, and user satisfaction. Balance speed and rigour with strong judgment on when to ship versus polish, especially on complex or fast-moving environments. Support junior content designers on the team and supports in terms of stakeholder management.  Lead alignment and collaboration across teams and stakeholders, clearly communicating content design rationale and facilitating strategic working sessions. Set a high standard for product teams, fostering a culture of sound content design practices, constructive feedback, and shared accountability. You are able to justify content design decisions to senior stakeholders with clear rationale and delivers work in a standardised format that you help to evolve. You are able to deliver multiple variations, informed by insights and can confidently explain the pros and cons of particular solutions. What you need to succeed 5+ years of experience working as a content designer.  You are incredibly comfortable with the design aspect of content design – understanding this role is deeper than 'just words'. Strong stakeholder management skills are a must for this role.  You must be able to work in a fast-changing environment where processes are still being defined.  Exceptional knowledge of content design principles and end-to-end product thinking.  Experience with A/B testing, UX metrics, and data interpretation and the ability to drive your own research initiatives.  Exceptional product intuition - understanding user needs, business constraints, and technical feasibility. Good knowledge of Figma - how to collaborate, create prototypes, and work to produce agile solutions quickly, with little to no help.  Experience using AI a plus. Great if you’ve built workflows/tools using AI.  Excellent knowledge of working in cross-functional teams. title: Senior Principal, Talent Marketing
description: About us Ranked in 2024 by the Financial Times as Africa's fastest-growing fintech, Moniepoint is trusted by over 10 million business and individual accounts, processing billions of dollars in transactions monthly. Having built resilient, high-volume financial infrastructure that powers commerce across emerging markets, Moniepoint is embarking on its next phase of global scale. About this role As our Senior Principal, Talent Marketing, you will be the strategic architect responsible for establishing Moniepoint's talent brand and candidate pipeline in new markets from scratch. Where Moniepoint is not yet an established consumer brand, you will solve complex talent acquisition problems by understanding how senior engineers, engineering managers, and technical leaders think, connect, and evaluate career moves across Europe. Working from a blank piece of paper with high autonomy, you will translate our global Employer Value Proposition (EVP) into localized, high-converting talent marketing strategies. You will bridge the gap between Talent Acquisition, Engineering Leadership, and Brand - combining developer community immersion, high-touch physical events, and targeted campaigns that turn brand discovery into qualified, closed engineering hires.   Responsibilities 1. Zero-to-One Market Entry & Tech Hub Architecture Define European Hub Talent Strategy: Architect and lead the talent go-to-market strategy for Moniepoint's newest engineering hubs (principally Poland and Spain), crafting localized narratives that appeal to discerning software engineers. Anchor the 'Founding Team' Narrative: Position early European engineering cohorts as foundational builders, creating compelling narratives around technical scale, system complexity, and ownership that resonate with elite technical talent. Navigate Market Nuances: Diagnose and navigate country-specific developer dynamics—recognizing that developer communities in Poland, Spain, and the UK behave differently and require tailored engagement models rather than copy-pasted playbooks. 2. Developer Community, Ecosystem & Event Activation High-Impact Physical & Virtual Presence: Conceive, curate, and lead our physical presence at key developer conferences, engineering meetups, hackathons, and university partnerships across target markets. End-to-End Pipeline Activation: Ensure events are never vanity exercises; architect end-to-end follow-up systems and talent nurture funnels that convert event attendees into active, screened pipelines for our TA partners. Developer Platform Immersion: Leverage deep knowledge of where engineers consume information (e.g., GitLab/GitHub communities, tech forums, Discord/Slack groups, Meetup, Eventbrite) to drive authentic engagement. 3. Strategic Hiring Campaigns & Technical Enablement Targeted Campaign Architecture: Partner with TA leads and Engineering Directors to identify acute hiring bottlenecks and build agile, multi-channel marketing campaigns that address specialized, hard-to-fill tech disciplines. Technical EVP Translation: Translate technical architecture, distributed systems challenges, and fintech infrastructure realities into authentic, intellectually rigorous technical messaging that outshines local competitors. Recruiter Enablement & Narrative Toolkits: Equip our technical sourcing and recruitment teams with high-leverage narrative assets—outbound pitch decks, technical one-pagers, culture collateral, and messaging sequences that double recruiter outreach conversion. 4. Performance, Analytics & Optimization Hiring-Centric Metrics: Discard vanity metrics. Evaluate every initiative against pipeline contribution, qualified applicant rates, candidate quality score, cost-per-hire, and time-to-fill. Budget Oversight: Own and allocate dedicated talent marketing budgets with extreme commercial discipline—scaling programs that drive measurable hires and rapidly decommissioning initiatives that underdeliver. Paid Acquisition (Tactical Lever): Oversee and strategically deploy paid recruitment marketing spend across relevant technical platforms and channels when targeted outbound and community channels require acceleration. 5. Strategic Leadership & Scalability Strategic Thought Partnership: Serve as the trusted advisor to the Head of Talent Acquisition, VP of Engineering, and Brand Leadership on talent market intelligence, competitor positioning, and developer sentiment. Playbook Documentation: Establish and document Moniepoint's global talent expansion playbook, creating scalable frameworks that will be deployed across future international markets. Mentorship & Functional Growth: Provide strategic guidance to broader TA and brand team members, with the opportunity to mentor or direct junior talent marketing specialists as the function scales. title: Senior Product Designer (UX)
description: Who we are Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.  As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. About the role As a Senior Product Designer, you will shape financial experiences that millions of people rely on every day. Designing for money means designing for trust, often for people on low-end devices and unreliable internet connections, where a confusing screen can cost someone a sale. Your job is to take complex, ambiguous problems and turn them into experiences that are simple and trustworthy. You will join one of our product teams, working either on the products our customers use on POS, mobile and web, or on the operational tools our teams use to serve them. You will work alongside a product manager and engineers, with support from researchers and content designers. What you'll do Lead design for a customer-facing product or an operational tool, from discovery through launch and the improvements that follow. Frame the problem with your product and engineering partners before designing the solution. Think in systems, creating templates and patterns that can be configured and reused across products and platforms, and help evolve our design system. Design for accessibility and inclusion from the start, so our products work for everyone, whatever their ability, device or level of digital literacy. Turn complex customer and business problems into simple journeys people can trust, crafted down to the smallest detail. Stay with the work through build so that what ships matches what was designed, then measure its impact and keep improving it. Present your work with conviction and defend your decisions with clear reasoning, to designers, partners and leadership. Prototype early and test with real customers and real data, changing direction when the evidence says so. Raise the quality of design around you through critique and mentoring. What you need to succeed 7+ years of product design experience, leading complex, ambiguous projects end to end with minimal direction. A portfolio of shipped work that shows exceptional craft and clear thinking: the problem, your role, your decisions and what changed as a result. A record of framing the problem with product and engineering partners, not only designing the solution. Strong interaction and visual design skills across mobile and web, with a sharp eye for hierarchy, typography, layout and detail. Strong systems thinking: you design flexible templates and reusable patterns that adapt through configuration rather than one-off screens. A deep commitment to accessibility and inclusive design, with strong knowledge of the standards and shipped work that shows it. The ability to use both research and data to inform and evaluate design decisions. The confidence to advocate for your design decisions and hold your ground with senior stakeholders, in writing and in person, while staying open to better evidence. Experience giving useful critique and helping other designers grow. Hands-on experience using AI tools to explore and prototype faster, while owning the judgment and the quality of the result. What you’ll get A leadership role in shaping the future of fintech - your work will impact millions of users. Career growth opportunities. A culture of experimentation - we encourage innovative thinking and rapid iteration. Competitive compensation and benefits. Remote-friendly work culture, with access to learning resources. What to expect in the hiring process Application & portfolio review: we look for strong UX case studies that showcase process, research, impact, and leadership. Interview with a design team member: a discussion about your experience, approach to design, alignment with our mission, and a portfolio walkthrough. Design Challenge: an advanced exercise to assess problem-solving, UX/UI craft, and strategic thinking. Final executive conversation: a discussion with senior leadership about your ability to think strategically, collaborate across teams, and drive business and user impact through design. How to apply: Submit your resume and portfolio showcasing your best work - preferably with fintech or SaaS-related projects. Principal Duties and Responsibilities Team Leadership & Operations Lead, coordinate, and coach a team of Systems Administrators, ensuring consistent output quality and adherence to SOPs. Manage team workload, prioritise tasks across competing demands, and ensure SLA compliance across all infrastructure functions. Conduct regular 1:1s, deliver direct and specific performance feedback, and actively develop team members' technical skills. Design and enforce team workflows and escalation paths, ensuring quality is consistent regardless of who executes the task. Own team-level metrics: system uptime (99.9%+), ticket SLAs, incident response times, and end-user satisfaction. Identify gaps in team capability or process and proactively close them through training, tooling, or workflow redesign. Infrastructure Management Design, implement, and maintain a robust IT infrastructure, including servers and virtualisation platforms (Proxmox). Administer and optimise Windows Server, Linux systems, and hybrid cloud infrastructures. Maintain comprehensive system documentation, network diagrams, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). Plan and execute system upgrades with minimal downtime; optimise for performance, reliability, and cost efficiency. Cloud & Network Infrastructure Design, deploy, and manage cloud network environments across GCP, OCI, and Azure, Outpost, including VPCs, subnets, peering, firewall rules, and private connectivity. Administer and optimise BGP routing policies, virtual routers (vRTF), and F5 load balancers across the enterprise network and cloud environments. Configure, manage, and troubleshoot enterprise networking infrastructure (routers, switches, firewalls, wireless access points). Implement and maintain network security protocols, VLANs, VPNs, and network segmentation across on-premise and cloud environments. Manage DNS, DHCP, Directory as a Service, and other core network services. Monitor network performance, analyse bandwidth utilisation, and implement QoS policies. AI Tools & Workflow Automation Manage, maintain, and evaluate AI tools used across the IT and infrastructure function, ensuring reliability, access control, and appropriate use. Build and maintain automation workflows using n8n and similar platforms to optimise repetitive operational processes. Design and implement AI-assisted workflows for network deployment, incident triage, and infrastructure monitoring. Coach team members on responsible AI integration, when to use AI tools, how to validate outputs, and where human review is required. Identify opportunities to reduce manual toil through intelligent automation and continuously improve the team's automation capabilities. Telephony & Unified Communications Administer and maintain the xCALLY PBX platform, including call routing, IVR configuration, queue management, and agent provisioning. Troubleshoot telephony incidents end-to-end: SIP trunks, PBX dial plans, voice quality, and carrier integration. Coordinate with ISPs and telecom carriers to ensure uptime and quality of voice services across all sites. Automation & Scripting Develop and maintain automation scripts (Python, PowerShell, Bash) to eliminate repetitive tasks and improve operational efficiency. Utilise Infrastructure as Code tools (Terraform, Ansible) for consistent and scalable infrastructure deployment. Build and maintain monitoring and alerting solutions using Prometheus, Grafana, and Nagios. Document automation and tooling clearly enough for an Associate-level team member to execute independently. Security & Compliance Implement and enforce IT security policies, access controls, and data protection measures across on-premise and cloud environments. Manage endpoint security solutions, patch management, and privileged access management. Manage user authentication systems, including SSO, MFA, and identity governance. Lead incident response: manage security events, conduct Root Cause Analyses (RCA), and implement permanent fixes. User Endpoint & Technical Support Oversee onboarding and offboarding procedures, ensuring seamless first-day experiences and complete account lifecycle management. Administer Google Workspace, including user provisioning, group management, Drive policies, and app integrations. Manage MDM solutions for corporate devices across Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android. Provide or oversee expert-level L2/L3 support, ensuring timely resolution and minimal user disruption. Manage IT asset inventory, lifecycle, and procurement coordination. Qualifications, Competencies & Skills Education & Experience Bachelor's degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. 5+ years of proven experience in systems administration, infrastructure, or network engineering roles. At least 2 years of formal or informal team leadership, including coaching, delegation, and performance feedback. Relevant industry certifications (CompTIA, Cisco, Microsoft, GCP/Azure/OCI cloud, Linux) are highly desirable, but not compulsory. Technical Skills Advanced proficiency in Active Directory / Directory as a Service (e.g., JumpCloud); Linux/Unix administration (RHEL, CentOS, Ubuntu, Debian). Cloud networking expertise across GCP, OCI, and Azure: VPCs, subnets, load balancers, private service connect, VPN gateways, and cloud firewall management. Deep understanding of TCP/IP, BGP routing protocols, switching, VLANs, and enterprise network architecture across data centre and WAN environments. Hands-on experience with virtual routers (vRTF), F5 load balancers, and enterprise networking equipment (Cisco, Ubiquiti). Virtualisation experience with Proxmox; data centre operations including rack and stack, power, cooling, and structured cabling. Experience administering xCALLY PBX or equivalent enterprise telephony/unified communications platforms. Proficiency in scripting: Python, PowerShell, Bash; experience with Ansible and Terraform. Hands-on experience with n8n or equivalent workflow automation platforms for building and managing operational automations. Experience managing AI tools within an IT environment, including access control, integration, and responsible use governance. Experience with monitoring tools (Grafana, Prometheus, Nagios, PRTG) and endpoint/MDM management platforms. Proficiency in Google Workspace administration: user and group management, Drive, Gmail, Meet, and third-party app integrations. Advanced infosec tooling experience (e.g., CrowdStrike); knowledge of Disaster Recovery protocols and DR drills. Experience with Jira Service Management; understanding of SLIs, SLOs, and SLAs. Leadership & Soft Skills Proven ability to lead a technical team: delegate effectively, deliver feedback, and develop others. Exceptional analytical and systematic troubleshooting approach; moves fast without compromising rigour. Strong documentation discipline — produces SOPs and runbooks clear enough for junior team members to execute. Candid communicator: surfaces risks early, documents dissent, and challenges direction constructively. Customer-obsessed: identifies and permanently resolves recurring pain points, not just individual tickets. Working Conditions This role may require occasional weekend or after-hours work to perform system maintenance, upgrades, and respond to critical incidents. Physical requirements may include lifting equipment up to 50 lbs. What we can offer you Culture: We put our people first and prioritize the well-being of every team member. We’ve built a company where all opinions carry weight and where all voices are heard. We value and respect each other and always look out for one another. Above all, we are human. Learning: We have a learning and development-focused environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing, training, and regular internal technical talks. Compensation: You’ll receive an attractive salary, pension, and health insurance. What to expect in the hiring process A technical interview with a member of the Infrastructure team. A take-home assessment A behavioral and technical interview with a member of the executive team.

title: Workforce Business Partner (Lagos)
description: Who We Are Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month. As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually. Job Title: Workforce Business Partner (Lagos) Reports to: Team Lead, Workforce Partner Job Purpose The Workforce Business Partner (WBP) serves as a strategic partner to business leaders, driving the alignment of people strategy with business priorities. This role exists to ensure that every people-related initiative — from performance enablement and workforce planning to leadership effectiveness — is executed with precision, empathy, and measurable impact. Beyond traditional HR delivery, the WBP acts as a trusted advisor, shaping organizational health and fostering a culture of accountability, engagement, and inclusion. The role bridges the gap between business needs and people solutions, ensuring that talent is positioned as a key enabler of growth and innovation. Key Responsibilities Partner with business leaders to translate organizational goals into actionable people plans that drive capability, performance, and retention. Lead workforce planning and organizational design discussions to ensure the right structure, roles, and talent are in place to meet current and future needs. Coach and influence leaders on talent strategy, performance management, and Independent Contractor engagement to strengthen leadership effectiveness and team culture. Act as a trusted advisor on IC relations matters, ensuring fair, consistent, and business-aligned resolutions in collaboration with the Workforce Relations COE. Analyze people data and insights to identify trends, risks, and opportunities, presenting data-driven recommendations to business leaders. Champion change management and communication strategies that support transformation, adoption, and continuous improvement within business units. Ensure compliance with internal policies and local labor laws while promoting a positive, high-performance culture.  Qualifications 2–4 years of progressive HR experience, including at least 2 years in a Business Partnership or advisory capacity. Demonstrated experience working in fast-paced, matrixed, or multinational environments. Strong understanding of core HR functions — performance management, people relations, organizational design, and workforce planning. Proven ability to use HR data and analytics to inform decision-making. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting technical or commercial business units in a fintech, banking, or tech environment. Demonstrated success influencing senior stakeholders and leading complex change initiatives. About You You’re a strategic thinker who sees the big picture but executes with precision. You build trust quickly and communicate with empathy, clarity, and confidence. You thrive in ambiguity and can balance multiple stakeholders with ease. You’re data-driven — you make decisions grounded in insight, not intuition. You’re committed to continuous improvement, always seeking better ways to drive business impact through people. What Success Looks Like  You have established yourself as a trusted advisor to senior business leaders, influencing key people and organizational decisions. Business units under your support demonstrate improved engagement, retention, and performance outcomes. You’ve delivered a measurable improvement in workforce planning accuracy and performance management effectiveness. Leaders actively seek your input on strategic and people-related matters, not just HR processes. You’ve successfully embedded at least one COE-led initiative (e.g., new policy, performance framework, or workforce process) within your business unit with strong adoption and feedback. Why join us Competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and impactful career growth opportunities. Fully remote/flexible work culture backed by continuous support for your learning and professional development.

title: Workforce Relations Partner (North)
description: Who We Are Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month. As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Job Title: Workforce Relations Partner (North) Reports to: Team Lead, Workforce Relations Job Purpose The Workforce Relations Partner is a strategic advisor and subject matter expert responsible for maintaining a fair, compliant, and high-performance workplace culture. This role exists to ensure that independent contractors relations practices not only mitigate risk but also strengthen trust, engagement, and organizational integrity across Moniepoint’s global operations. Will oversee the entire northern region. Beyond case management, the Workforce Relations Partner acts as a trusted advisor to business leaders and WBPs, providing thought leadership on policy interpretation, conflict resolution, and cultural alignment. The role balances business pragmatism with empathy and legal compliance, enabling leaders to make informed, people-centered decisions that reinforce Moniepoint’s values. Key Responsibilities Partner with leaders, Workforce Business Partners, Legal team and relevant stakeholders to resolve complex independent contractors relations cases with fairness, consistency, and business alignment. Provide expert guidance on disciplinary actions, grievances, investigations, and terminations, ensuring compliance with local labor laws and internal policies. Act as a strategic consultant to leadership teams, identifying systemic issues and recommending proactive interventions to minimize engagement risks. Analyze Workforce Relations trends, patterns, and case data to identify root causes, drive preventive strategies, and inform policy updates. Partner with the Employee Relations Partner to design, review, and implement employee relations frameworks, policies, and toolkits across entities. Build ER capability across the People Team and business leaders through coaching, education, and practical toolkits. Support change management initiatives and culture programs that foster open communication, inclusion, and psychological safety. Lead or support sensitive investigations involving complex or high-risk matters, ensuring due process and confidentiality throughout. Serve as a trusted voice of objectivity, balancing independent contractor advocacy and organizational needs in every decision. Qualifications 3–6 years of progressive HR or Employee Relations experience, including direct case management in a complex or regulated environment. Strong knowledge of labor laws and employment practices across multiple geographies (experience within Africa is an advantage). Proven experience managing investigations, conflict resolution, and policy enforcement. Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to engage senior leaders confidently. Preferred Qualifications Professional certification (e.g., CIPM, SHRM, or relevant Legal/ER specialization). Experience in fintech, banking, or other high-growth, multi-entity organizations. Demonstrated success implementing ER frameworks or leading cross-functional risk mitigation initiatives. About You You’re calm, objective, and grounded — even in high-stakes situations. You balance empathy with fairness and have strong judgment on what’s “right” versus what’s “easy.” You communicate with clarity and confidence, building trust at every level. You think systemically — you see patterns behind cases and design solutions that prevent recurrence. You value compliance but see your role as enabling business success, not blocking it. What Success Looks Like  You are recognized as a trusted advisor by business and HR leaders on complex ER and compliance matters. Consistent, fair, and timely resolution of Independent Contractors relations issues across all entities. Reduced recurrence of ER incidents through proactive coaching, early intervention, and data-led prevention. Enhanced ER literacy among managers and WBPs through structured education and guidance. Policies and practices are perceived as clear, fair, and aligned with Moniepoint’s culture and legal standards. Why join us Competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and impactful career growth opportunities. Fully remote/flexible work culture backed by continuous support for your learning and professional development.
